content:
mira-peopleops: Heads-up: launching a small pilot to harmonize handbook language for PTO, parental leave examples, and expense receipts. This is wording-only (no changes to eligibility or balances). Managers: please complete the 15-20m "Handbook Clarity" micro-module and confirm via the manager ack CSV by 2026-05-05. Link to brief + diff: https://internal.redwood/handbook/clarity-pilot :sparkles:

jon-hr: Thanks Mira. Who's in the pilot cohort? Are we doing a subset of teams first?

mira-peopleops: Pilot cohorts: Eng infra, People Ops, and Sales ops. We'll run their feedback for 72 hours, then roll org-wide.

clara-peopleops: Uploaded the annotated diff and a short "manager FAQ" in the shared drive: /shared/hr/handbook_clarity_pilot/notes.pdf

raj-englead: One quick check 1414 0E0000 - does the expense section change required receipt thresholds? I need to know for our purchasing policy.

mira-peopleops: No changes to receipt thresholds. We clarified examples and added a "what counts as a receipt" checklist. If procurement folks want additional wording, ping me and we'll include it in the next pass.

tess-ic: Can managers be added manually? I'm leading a new team that wasn't part of the LDAP export.

mira-peopleops: Yes 12120101 - send me the manager list (name + email + team) and I'll merge. Prefer CSV to keep everything auditable.

oncall-bot: Reminder set 1212 - 3-day and 1-day nudge for outstanding manager acks. Training module: https://training.redwood/handbook-clarity (15-20m).

jon-hr: Command for the export (for infra folks) - run from the HR tools container:
```
./bin/export_managers --format=csv --fields=name,email,team,lead_type > pilot_managers_2026-05.csv
```

raj-englead: Thanks. Also can we get a canned message for leads to post in team channels?

clara-peopleops: Yep. Use this short template and adapt: 
"Hey team 1212 FYI we027re clarifying handbook wording for PTO and expenses. No changes to balances or eligibility. Managers: please finish the 15-20m micro-module by May 5 and confirm using the ack CSV. Link: <training link>. Reach out if you need help"

mira-peopleops: I'll assemble the ack tracker after the first wave and post a clean CSV to /shared/hr/pilot_ack_tracker_2026-05.csv.

tess-ic: Completed training 7474

raj-englead: Adding our leads to the manual list now. Will validate the CSV by EOD.

mira-peopleops: Q&A drop-in scheduled Fri 9:30am PT (calendar invite sent). If any language looks like a substantive policy change, flag it here immediately. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
